observation_target: New inundation visible at the Sentinel-1 post acquisition 2024-09-15T23:16:01Z relative to 2024-09-03T23:16:00Z, inside AOI-01; not the full September flood peak.

grid.origin: T47QNC event blue 10 m COG affine origin

reflectance.invalid_band_rule: unobservable for event; uncertain if dry context is needed for a water cell

A.threshold_policy: The pinned pretrained package selects its internal model and NDWI thresholds; no agent-selected or SAR-tuned threshold is permitted.

B.invalid_denominator_rule: unobservable for event; uncertain if dry context is needed for a water cell

unobservable.buffer_distance: Euclidean distance between 10 m pixel centers, inclusive

permanent_water_rule: For event water agreed by A and B, code 2 only if both A and B also say water on observable 5 September cells; code 1 only if both say dry there; otherwise code 3 uncertain.

cross_review_limit_justifications.min_water_dice: A Dice of at least 0.60 requires substantial overlap of the two automated water maps before their consensus is highlighted.
cross_review_limit_justifications.min_cohen_kappa: Kappa of at least 0.50 requires chance-adjusted agreement beyond the large dry background.

candidate_products.threshold_policy: Use the existing frozen candidate mask; no re-thresholding.
Use the existing frozen candidate mask; no re-thresholding.

final_holdout_rule: One exclusive automated_holdout_consumption marker for one result containing both predeclared candidates; never reopen or rerun final_holdout.

acceptance_limit_justifications.min_iou: IoU of at least 0.30 rejects a severely mismatched flood footprint while allowing the known same-day timing gap.
acceptance_limit_justifications.min_precision: Precision of at least 0.50 requires at least half of predicted flooded cells to agree with the automated optical map.
acceptance_limit_justifications.min_recall: Recall of at least 0.50 rejects a candidate that misses most optically mapped temporary water.
acceptance_limit_justifications.max_abs_area_error_fraction: Area error no greater than 0.50 rejects candidates whose predicted flooded area differs from the optical map by more than half.
acceptance_limit_justifications.min_evaluated_coverage: Coverage of at least 0.50 prevents a mostly abstaining or out-of-footprint candidate from passing on a tiny scored subset.

possible_recession_rule: Count reference code 1 with candidate code 0 separately as a time-gap diagnostic; this is not proof of recession and does not change the confusion matrix.
metric_interpretation: Agreement with an automated optical map, not accuracy.
